title: The Betrothed by Scarlett Grace McCarthy at WP Theater #thebetrothed ...
transcript: In The Betrothed by Scarlett Grace McCarthy, a young woman named Kitty stumbles through a grand attempt to save her brother's engagement while finding a love of her own. A series of comedic mishaps and personal revelations make all of the characters rethink what they know about love. In many ways, it's a generic romp — the plot isn't the most inventive, and the characters, though fleshed out, are rather archetypal. That said, the performances are quite charming, and it's not always easy to toe the line between camp and cringe. The highlight of the production is possibly the most unexpected character, an illiterate, feral nun brought to life by Abby Erff in an absolutely brilliant performance. If this were a sitcom, she would need her own spin off. And in some ways, the piece does operate like a sitcom — all of the scenes are short and sweet, and it grows funnier the more outlandish it gets. While The Betrothed isn't without a few clunky moments, I thought it was a solid comedy and made for a pleasant night. With that, another program for my collection.
